title: Two five-field degree-100 cyclic components with radius 24 with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit product of two five-field degree-100 cyclic codes with the fixed radius-24 adaptive list decoder has average block error at most 222889346700466343/1000000000000000000 on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) channel uses with uniform 1000-bit input.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder takes at most W=1529510179389033649880402611874359160 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(120203/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all 33 averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), 126 exact child-removal shells (2), and the final cumulative two-component error (3).
